events.name: Barbie Girl Dance
events.description: Two people in a bright front hall turn round to the phone and do the Barbie Girl couple dance side by side: fists pumping, arm swings, a hip-to-hip lean, back to back, and a spin into each other.

events.name: CCTV Tiger Fight
events.description: A grainy security camera on a forest path: you walk up it, a tiger steps out of the bushes and leaps at you, and a few seconds later you are kneeling on it, pinning it to the ground.

events.name: Tsundere Stomp
events.description: You bounce on your toes facing the phone, then do the tsundere stomp again and again: a high kick, arms flung wide, then arms folded tight as you turn your head away.

events.name: Old Town Road
events.description: You sing Old Town Road to the camera in a black cowboy hat in a bright candy shop, then ride off in the red convertible with a money bag, seen from straight above. With a friend, they're the one in the white hat holding the money bag out of the car.

events.name: St Tropez DJ
events.description: You're the DJ of a packed Saint-Tropez beach club: at the decks in a purple tie-dye T-shirt, you throw both arms up and clap above your head, wave to the crowd and turn back to the mixer while everyone films you.
